name: Resizer
purpose: Drag handle between two columns. Sets the split ratio or the aside width. A 4px grab strip with a 1px hairline in its centre. The 1px rules in the draft and multi-inspector shots are this widget with reset none.
base: shadcn Resizable handle (ResizableHandle; react-resizable-panels; not Radix)

values.when: Split divider. Double-click restores the default split (resetSplitRatio, App.tsx:84).
Drag only: preview edge, draft-inspector and multi-inspector resizers.

props.name: value
props.description: splitRatio (0.25 to 0.75) or previewWidth (280 to 420 px).

role: separator, focusable, aria-orientation vertical, aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax (proposed; the reference records no role)
keyboard: Reference: pointer only. Proposed: Left and Right step the value; Home (and Enter, per A) restores the default on the double-click variant.
platform: Same pointer behaviour and col-resize cursor on both. Touch drag is not recorded in the reference.
open: Name: A's Resizer is kept; B's ResizeHandle is the same job and is dropped as a duplicate name. Clamps: split ratio 0.25 to 0.75 (App.tsx:78-82); preview width 280 to 420 px (App.tsx:110-115). Drag-only resizers in draft-inspector and multi-inspector carry onResize only. No keyboard path in the catalogue (a gap for both designs).
